query:
update ticket_kinds set
                    purchasing_available_start = $2,
                    purchasing_available_stop = $3,
                    name = $4,
                    max_tickets = $5,
                    min_tickets = $6,
                    allow_transfer_ticket_start = $7,
                    allow_transfer_ticket_stop = $8,
                    allow_transfer_ticket_bypass_allowed_groups = $9
                where id = $1
